visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women stand on an outdoor rooftop terrace under a clear, bright blue sky. The woman on the left wears a short, white, tiered dress and holds a bouquet of bright yellow roses. The woman on the right, with her back to the camera, wears a grey long-sleeve crop top and wide-leg denim jeans. They are surrounded by low green hedges and a stone-tiled floor. (2) The woman in the grey top turns around to face the camera, and the woman in the white dress hands her the yellow bouquet. They both smile and begin a synchronized dance, swaying their hips and moving their arms rhythmically. (3) The scene cuts to an indoor hallway with glossy, reflective wall panels. The two women are walking forward while continuing their dance moves. The woman in the grey top now holds the flowers. (4) They appear inside an elevator with mirrored stainless steel walls and marble trim. The woman in the grey top holds the elevator door open with her hand while both continue their energetic, synchronized posing and dancing. (5) The final phase takes place in a carpeted indoor hallway with warm, bright lighting. They stand close together, performing coordinated hand and leg movements, facing the camera with cheerful expressions.
